test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "5811c8e0efbd113282f5081045e2d69df7808b08"

npm run lint
npm run build
cd ..
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-place-preview-race-e2e-XXXXXX)

cd frontend
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- e2e/visual/admin-place-photo-preview-race.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-queue-race.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-photo-race.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-lazy-loading.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep-invert 'visual:'
cd ..
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
